title: price whether a directory-valued published field holds a published face name or a face home directory, and whether any row's join lands on a real file
method_limits: a name collision is decided on the basename, so two different directories with the same leaf name count once per row and not once per directory
the composition is priced against paths that exist on THIS tree at scan time; a row whose target is created later is graded lands_on_nothing today
a row offering several name fields is graded lands if any of them lands; the published join_target names which one did
faces larger than 3 MB are not scanned by the shared scanner, so a census carrying such a field is outside this population
